def transform(grid):
    # Duplicate the outermost rows and columns, leaving the center single.
    rows = [row for i, row in enumerate(grid) for _ in (range(2) if i in (0, len(grid) - 1) else range(1))]
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        expanded = [cell for j, cell in enumerate(row) for _ in (range(2) if j in (0, len(row) - 1) else range(1))]
        out.append(expanded)
    return out
